heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: 111 dead, 1,631 injured after M7.7 quake struck 68km NNW of Ende at 10km depth on 15 August; the death toll remains unchanged since 27 August (Day 19). BMKG's aftershock count has passed 10,937 (1 September), with the decay curve continuing its downward trend toward a forecast late-September tail-off. Recovery is widening beyond emergency relief: the Agriculture Ministry has distributed 1,321.55 tons of rice and 7,000 liters of cooking oil across all seven affected regencies, and five quake-damaged airports are undergoing expedited structural repairs.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
